translation.name: Biblica® Open Nkanda wu Moyo, Nguizani Yimona ayi Minkunga 2002
translation.englishName: Yombe: Biblica® Open Nkanda wu Moyo, Nguizani Yimona ayi Minkunga 2002 (Bible)

content.text: Luzitisa Yave ;
luyimbidila Yave nkunga wumona ;
nzitusu andi mu lukutukunu lu banlongo.
Bika Iseli kamona khini mu diambu di mvangi awu
Bika batu ba Sioni bayangalala mu diambu di ntinu awu.
Bika bazitisa dizina diandi mu makinu ;
ayi bansikila miziki mu ndungu ayi mu ngitala,
bila Yave weti yangalala mu batu bandi,
weti vuatisa phulusu kuidi batu beti kukikula.
Bika banlongo bamoma khan mu diambu di nzitusu wawu ;
ayi bayimbila mu khan mu zimbuka ziawu.
Bika minzitusu mi Nzambi miba mu miunu miawu
ayi sabala kidi meno mu zindambu zioso mu mioko miawu ;
mu diambu di vutula landi kuidi makanda
ayi mu vana batu thumbudulu ;
mu diambu di kanga mintinu miawu mu zisieni
ayi batu bawu banneni mu bisengo ;
mu diambu di dukisa nzengolo yoyi yisonama mu diambu diawu ;
wawu wawu nkembo wu banlongo bandi boso.
Luzitisa Yave.
